items.name: experimental-design
items.declared_license: MIT license in SKILL.md; independently verify attribution and redistribution terms before reuse
items.decision: Create a distinct, scoped experimental-design skill covering allocation concealment, block-restricted randomization, factorial aliasing and preregistered monitoring; existing owner only touches randomized units and clustering.
items.finding: Do not copy the overstatement that randomization alone turns a comparison into a causal claim. The scripts expose reproducible allocation but cannot guarantee concealment. Tests describe design properties, but were not run.
items.limits: Full listed package texts read; dependency versions and rights not independently resolved; no execution, live behavior, external service or clinical validation.

items.name: marine-carbonate-chemistry
items.declared_license: MIT in SKILL.md; verify source and dependency terms before reuse
items.decision: Create a distinct bounded research capability for seawater carbonate equilibrium, requiring independent inputs, explicit measurement conditions and uncertainty scope; no air-sea flux or carbon-removal claim from equilibrium alone.
items.finding: The local owners lack this specialized calculation; tests are largely solver-internal regressions and cannot establish independent field validation.
items.limits: Full package texts and test file read; no tests executed and solver version, numerical validity, data and license terms not independently verified.

items.name: cellprofiler
items.declared_license: MIT in SKILL.md; verify upstream asset and dependency terms before reuse
items.decision: Create a focused research microscopy workflow for sample metadata, calibration, segmentation quality and independent biological replicates, without implying diagnostic use.
items.finding: The upstream helper separates CSV integrity from real segmentation; its own review says its engine integration was skipped. A successful software check cannot establish microscopy assay accuracy.
items.limits: Full source package and test text read; no test executed; dependency versions, licenses, scientific validity and runtime claims not independently validated.

remaining: All other scientific source skills require individual full-package and owner reviews.
